description: Prepare a direct Aave V3 Pool withdrawal for a supported fixed reserve. Pass uint256 maximum as amount to request the available aToken balance. The wallet establishes balance, health-factor, collateral, and liquidity validity by exact simulation.

amount.description: Positive underlying-token amount in base units; uint256 maximum requests all available balance (positive decimal integer)

asset.description: Exact underlying ERC-20 address from the selected market's fixed major-reserve list

chain_id.description: Chain of a fixed Aave V3 core market returned by get_aave_v3_markets

sender.description: Wallet that will execute the Aave action (address)

name: prepare_aave_v3_withdraw
title: Prepare an Aave V3 withdrawal
